<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" pages="13" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="pqJBHrvm1hUB1H--sbtc"> <mxGraphModel dx="2142" dy="1342" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
actor U as User
participant G as LoginScreen
participant A as AuthController
participant R as RecognitionModel
participant S as AccountStore
Note over U,S: UC-01 Authenticate User - Login (normal scenario and exceptions)
U->>G: Select Login (face or voice)
G->>A: requestLogin(method)
alt E4 - camera or microphone unavailable
A-->>G: deviceUnavailable
G-->>U: Selected method can't be completed (app keeps running)
else device available
A-->>G: Activate camera or mic, show indicator
U->>G: Provide sample
G->>A: submitSample(sample)
A->>R: classify(sample)
R-->>A: predicted user, confidence
alt confidence at or above threshold
A->>S: loadAccount(userId)
S-->>A: account
alt account active - normal scenario
A-->>G: session(role)
G-->>U: Home page
else E3 - account suspended
A-->>G: loginRefused
G-->>U: Account suspended, contact bookstore
end
else E2 - confidence below threshold
A-->>G: notRecognized
G-->>U: User not recognized, retry
end
end",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"

 "data": "sequenceDiagram
actor U as Visitor
participant G as LoginScreen
participant A as AuthController
participant R as RecognitionModel
participant S as AccountStore
Note over U,S: UC-01 Authenticate User - Enrollment (alternate scenario and exception)
U->>G: Select Register, enter username (jlee)
U->>G: Provide several face images
G->>A: enroll(username, samples)
A->>S: usernameExists(username)
S-->>A: result
alt E1 - no usable sample or username already exists
A-->>G: enrollmentRejected
G-->>U: Please retry, no account created
else valid enrollment - alternate scenario
A->>R: updateModel(samples)
R-->>A: ok
A->>S: createAccount(username, RC, balance 0.00, warnings 0)
S-->>A: ok
A-->>G: enrolled
G-->>U: Registered, can log in immediately
end",

 "data": "sequenceDiagram
actor U as User
participant G as CatalogScreen
participant C as CatalogController
participant B as BookStore
participant H as HistoryStore
Note over U,H: UC-02 Browse Books (normal scenario and exceptions)
U->>G: Open catalog, choose category (Science Fiction)
G->>C: listBooks(category, author, or date)
C->>B: query(criteria)
B-->>C: matching books
alt books found
C-->>G: book list
U->>G: Select book (Dune)
G->>C: getDetails(bookId)
C->>B: getBook(bookId)
B-->>C: book details
alt user logged in - normal scenario
C->>H: recordView(userId, bookId, date)
H-->>C: ok
else E2 - user not logged in
Note over C,H: No browsing history recorded
end
C-->>G: details
G-->>U: Title, author, description, price, ratings, reviews
else E1 - no books in selected category, author, or date
C-->>G: empty
G-->>U: No books in this category
end",

actor U as Registered Customer

U->>G: Enter author keyword (Asimov)
G->>C: search(text)

alt results found - normal scenario

G->>C: getDetails(bookId)
C->>B: getBook(bookId)
B-->>C: book details
C-->>G: details
G-->>U: Foundation details
else E2 - no results
C-->>G: empty
G-->>U: No books found (query kept for refinement)
end",

 "data": "sequenceDiagram
actor U as Visitor
participant G as SearchScreen
participant C as SearchController
participant I as ImageMatcher
participant B as BookStore
Note over U,B: UC-03 Search for Books - Image search (normal scenario and exceptions)
U->>G: Upload JPEG photo of a book cover
G->>C: search(image)
C->>I: validate(image)
alt E3 - file is not a readable image
I-->>C: invalidImage
C-->>G: Reject file
G-->>U: Please upload a JPEG or PNG
else readable image
I->>B: getCoverImages()
B-->>I: stored cover images
I-->>C: books ranked by similarity
opt E1 - text criteria also given
C->>B: matchText(criteria)
B-->>C: matching books
C->>C: keep only books matching both
end
alt results found - normal scenario
C-->>G: ranked list
G-->>U: Closest matches, best first
U->>G: Select top result
else E2 - no results
C-->>G: empty
G-->>U: No books found (query kept for refinement)
end
end",

 "data": "sequenceDiagram
actor U as Visitor
participant G as ChatScreen

Note over U,L: UC-05 Interact with AI Chatbot - RAG answer (normal scenario and exception)
U->>G: Ask What are the store hours?
G->>C: ask(question, session)
C->>P: checkAccess(role, question)
alt E1 - restricted data for this role
P-->>C: denied
C-->>G: Access restriction message
else permitted - normal scenario
P-->>C: allowed
C->>R: retrieve(question, role)
R-->>C: relevant passages (store hours)
C->>L: generate(question, passages)
L-->>C: answer
C-->>G: answer, Source RAG
end
G-->>U: Display response",

 "data": "sequenceDiagram
actor U as VIP Customer
participant G as PurchaseScreen
participant C as PurchaseController
participant R as RuleEngine
participant S as AccountStore
participant H as HistoryStore
Note over U,H: UC-06 Purchase Books - Normal scenario and exceptions E4, E1
U->>G: Select Purchase on a 30.00 book
G->>C: requestPurchase(userId, bookId)
C->>S: loadAccount(userId)
S-->>C: status, role, balance
alt E4 - not authenticated or account suspended
C-->>G: purchaseNotAllowed
G-->>U: Purchase is not allowed
else authenticated and active
C->>R: calculatePrice(role, price)
R-->>C: 27.00 (10% VIP discount)
C-->>G: price
G-->>U: Show 27.00 and ask to confirm
alt E1 - customer cancels at checkout
U->>G: Cancel
G-->>U: No changes made
else customer confirms - normal scenario
U->>G: Confirm
G->>C: confirm(purchase)
C->>S: deduct(userId, 27.00)
S-->>C: new balance 53.00
C->>H: recordPurchase(userId, bookId, 27.00, date)
H-->>C: ok
C->>R: runStatusCheck(userId)
R-->>C: no status change
C-->>G: purchase complete, new balance
G-->>U: Show new balance 53.00
end
end",

 "data": "sequenceDiagram
actor U as Customer
participant G as PurchaseScreen
participant C as PurchaseController
participant R as RuleEngine
participant S as AccountStore
participant H as HistoryStore
Note over U,H: UC-06 Purchase Books - Insufficient balance (exceptions E2 and E3)
U->>G: Confirm purchase of a 40.00 book (balance 25.00)
G->>C: confirm(purchase)
C->>S: getBalance(userId)
S-->>C: balance 25.00
Note over C: E2 - price exceeds balance
C->>S: deduct(userId, 40.00 + 1.00 fine)
S-->>C: new balance
C->>H: recordPurchase(userId, bookId, 40.00, date)
H-->>C: ok
C->>R: runStatusCheck(userId)
alt E3 - balance is negative after E2
R->>S: setStatus(suspended) (UC-09)
S-->>R: ok
R-->>C: account suspended
C-->>G: purchase complete, account suspended
G-->>U: Contact the bookstore
else balance not negative
R-->>C: no status change
C-->>G: purchase complete, fine applied
G-->>U: Show new balance
end",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"

 "data": "sequenceDiagram
actor U as Registered Customer
participant G as AccountScreen
participant A as AccountController
participant S as AccountStore
Note over U,S: UC-07 Manage Account Balance - Deposit (normal scenario and exceptions E1, E3)
U->>G: Open My Account
G->>A: getSummary(userId)
A->>S: loadAccount(userId)
S-->>A: balance 12.00, history, warnings 0, status
A-->>G: summary
G-->>U: Show balance, purchase history, warnings
U->>G: Deposit 40.00
G->>A: deposit(amount)
alt E1 - invalid amount (negative, zero, or not a number)
A-->>G: Enter a valid amount
G-->>U: Amount rejected, ask for a valid amount
else amount valid
A->>S: saveBalance(balance + amount)
alt saved - normal scenario
S-->>A: ok
A-->>G: New balance 52.00
G-->>U: Show new balance 52.00
else E3 - balance update can't be saved
S-->>A: error
A-->>G: Operation unsuccessful (no partial change)
G-->>U: Operation unsuccessful
end
end",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"

 "data": "sequenceDiagram
actor U as Suspended Customer
actor SU as Super-User
participant G as AccountScreen
participant A as AccountController
participant S as AccountStore
Note over U,S: UC-07 Manage Account Balance - E2 suspended account
U->>G: Open My Account
G->>A: getSummary(userId)
A->>S: loadAccount(userId)
S-->>A: status suspended
A-->>G: Account suspended, contact the Super-User
G-->>U: Contact the Super-User to deposit
Note over SU,S: Super-User handles the deposit
SU->>A: recordDeposit(userId, amount)
A->>S: saveBalance(balance + amount)
S-->>A: ok
alt balance now positive
SU->>A: reopen(userId)
A->>S: setStatus(active)
S-->>A: ok
A-->>SU: Account reopened
else balance still not positive
A-->>SU: Account stays suspended (SR-13)
end",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"

 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 actor U as User
 participant G as CatalogScreen
 participant C as CatalogController
 participant B as BookStore
 participant H as HistoryStore

 G->>C: listBooks(category, author, or date)
 C->>B: query(criteria)
 B-->>C: matching books
 alt books found
 C-->>G: book list
 U->>G: Select book
 G->>C: getDetails(bookId)
 C->>B: getBook(bookId)
 B-->>C: book details
 opt user is logged in
 C->>H: recordView(userId, bookId, date)
 end
 C-->>G: details
 G-->>U: Title, author, price, ratings, reviews
 else no books
 C-->>G: empty
 G-->>U: No books in this category
 endan ",
